description: This file contains the source code for the 'Authorize' class in the Opencart catalog controller startup namespace, responsible for handling authorization logic within the OpenCart platform.

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: This class manages the authorization process for admin users in the OpenCart catalog startup namespace, extending the core Controller and implementing the index method for authorization checks based on tokens and route security.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles authorization checks by inspecting request parameters, cookies, and route security settings, returning appropriate actions or null if no authorization is needed.
